name: 19522 · Fleetwood, PA
findings: ZIP 19522 (Fleetwood) has 46 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19522 (Fleetwood) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
39% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19522 (Fleetwood) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 52% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
